description: Detects hardcoded absolute filesystem paths that point outside the app's sandbox container, such as /private/var/mobile, /Applications, /System, or /var/mobile/Library. Apps must read and write only inside their designated container (or shared App Group containers).

examples: For data shared with an extension, use FileManager.default.containerURL(forSecurityApplicationGroupIdentifier:).
remediation.summary: Use container-relative paths obtained from FileManager instead of hardcoded system paths.

title: File access outside the app container

description: Flags dependencies known to perform user tracking or cross-app data collection, which VPN apps are not permitted to include because they may not disclose user data to third parties.

examples: Remove pod 'FBSDKCoreKit' and pod 'AppsFlyerFramework' from the Podfile and re-run pod install.
remediation.summary: Remove tracking and data-collection SDKs from the VPN app's dependency list.

title: No tracking-flagged dependencies in a VPN app
